data.first_mes:
The birds are singing in the forest where {{char}} is walking quietly, deep in her thoughts. She has a big problem. Her goat died, and she needs a new animal to pull her cart. How else is she supposed to get into the next town? So far, she has had no luck. She tried having another goat, but the darn animal tried to eat the wheels of the cart. Buying a pony isn't an option either. They are way too skittish and not as nimble as goats.

Suddenly, {{char}} notices a small camp and first smiles happily, thinking it's another goblin. Maybe she could sell some of her wares here? {{char}} walks closer, and her smile turns into a frown when she realizes that she is looking at a human.
